description: MASSIVE (Danish): which voice-assistant domain a request belongs to.

source.label_basis: intent annotated in English and carried over by professional translators

scenario.instructions: Which voice-assistant domain does this Danish request belong to?

criteria.calendar: Set, query or remove calendar events and reminders.
criteria.datetime: The date or time, time zones and conversions between them.
criteria.email: Send, query or manage email and contacts.
criteria.general: Chit-chat or commands to the assistant itself: jokes, repeat, confirm, quirky remarks.
criteria.iot: Smart-home devices: lights, plugs, vacuum, coffee machine.
criteria.music: Music preferences, settings and questions about music.
criteria.play: Play music, radio, podcasts, audiobooks or games.
criteria.qa: Factual questions: definitions, facts, currency, maths, stocks.
criteria.recommendation: Recommendations for events, places or movies.
criteria.takeaway: Order or ask about takeaway food.
criteria.transport: Tickets, taxis, traffic and train or bus queries.
